record.body:
## Description

Replace phase detail with a tabbed PhaseScreen, wire main-screen p/s/e, phase navigation, Esc, and o.

## Approach

1. Add dashboard/phase_screen.py with PhaseScreen and panes Overview, Spec, Design, Decisions, Evidence, Tasks per the design.
2. Move stage strip, chips, requirement list, and task list into panes; Spec splits Requirements into OptionList + Markdown (R4); simple Spec shows phase body (R5).
3. Bind p/s/e on the main screen and left/right/p/s/d/e/t/[ /]/a/h/o/escape on PhaseScreen (R1,R2,R10,R12).
4. Wire o through pager helpers from spec-pager (R11). Keep tab, toggles, and scroll on reload (R13).
5. Cover with tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py. Migrate existing phase-detail layout assertions.
